scope: Support Pack costume canonical equipment-layer capacity decision
purpose: Determine whether five exact, source-backed costume identities can be promoted without inventing unsupported equipment IDs.
evidence: Current repository continuation guidance explicitly says not to invent equip-141 through equip-150 records.
equipment canonicalization already uses separate acc-### identities for accessories, so forcing clothing into the accessory namespace would violate domain identity.
The five identities have exact names and independent evidence, but no existing canonical equip ID.
decision: Do not promote the five costumes into the current canonical equipment layer in this cycle.
rationale: The repository currently treats equip-001 through equip-140 as a bounded legacy endpoint namespace, and its current continuation guidance explicitly prohibits inventing equip-141+ records. No documented allocation mechanism for a new equipment-ID generation range was found. Therefore creating sequential IDs would be architectural invention rather than evidence-backed promotion.
prohibited_actions: Alias an unmatched clothing identity to a similar named costume
Move clothing identities into acc-### solely to obtain canonical IDs
safe_future_path: Design an explicit next-generation equipment canonical-ID allocation/catalog mechanism before promoting these records; that mechanism must preserve exact identity, provenance, PQ/shop relationships, and compatibility with the combined equipment-accessory layer and reverse indexes.
next_action: Leave the five as explicit evidence-backed inventory gaps and proceed to the next highest-impact cross-domain consumer/coverage audit until a principled equipment-ID extension mechanism is designed.
